project_info.theme: Viettel TV360 football hero replay moment with CR7-inspired caller ID
project_info.color_palette: Viettel red, white, black, emerald green accents, multicolor ribbon, stadium crimson

main_subject.detail: A dramatic football-star scene with a CR7-like player in a red Portugal-style jersey number 7 stepping out in front of a giant tilted smartphone call screen. The phone display shows: 'Cuộc gọi đến', 'ANH 7', '0977 777 777', and 'Số Viettel'. Large red headline text on the left reads 'ANH 7 GỌI ĐẾN'. The lower-left copy says 'CR7 ghi bàn tại 6 kỳ World Cup' and 'Mở TV360 xem lại khoảnh khắc lịch sử'.
main_subject.style: Heroic photoreal sports advertising composite, cinematic stadium energy, oversized call-screen gimmick

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square advertising poster for a Viettel TV360 football hero replay moment with a CR7-inspired caller ID concept. Centerpiece is a dramatic photoreal football star in a red Portugal-style number 7 jersey posed in front of a giant tilted smartphone. The exact visible text must include 'ANH 7 GỌI ĐẾN', 'Cuộc gọi đến', 'ANH 7', '0977 777 777', 'Số Viettel', 'SIUUU!!', 'CR7 ghi bàn tại 6 kỳ World Cup', and 'Mở TV360 xem lại khoảnh khắc lịch sử'. Background is a red glowing stadium with bright sparks and a giant phone call interface. Surrounding elements: Viettel telecom logo at top left, multicolor ribbon sweeping across the lower half, and an official-style World Cup football in the foreground. Technical style: photoreal cinematic sports advertising composite, cinematic stadium lighting, glowing flares and hard rim lights, 8k resolution, highly detailed.

Preserve all visible wording exactly and maintain the oversized phone, stadium background, and heroic red color dominance.
